hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/oscar-scherer-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('104 fully equipped campsites with electric and water hookups for tents or RVs') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 93 web-bookable units Water Hookup; 55 list 50-amp electric, 38 list 30-amp; none lists sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 104 campsites in Loops A-E (the same page's Camping section says 101); 93 are bookable online. Per-site limits run 15 to 36 ft, about 46 sites taking 36 ft and about 18 under 25 ft. The six Loop E sites are paved pull-throughs (bring leveling boards); the rest are back-in. Seven ADA sites. Several sites along the creek are not pet-friendly. Some sites' water spigot is 40-58 ft away (bring extra hose).

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/oscar-scherer-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Maximum RV length = 36 feet', 'seven ADA accessible sites', 'Several campsites along the creek are not pet-friendly due to their proximity to the water') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facilities 139-143 (VehicleLength 15-36, PullInTypeName, site descriptions), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/oscar-scherer-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The clean, accessible restrooms have hot showers and laundry facilities', 'Laundry facilities are available in the campground for use by registered campers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521. The primitive group camp is booked by calling the park.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/oscar-scherer-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'; group camp: 'Please call the park at 941-483-5956 to make reservations'), read 2026-10-21

note: South Creek runs through the park; Reserve Florida describes 34 sites in Loops A and D (1-17, 70-90) as adjacent to a creek. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 104 sites (93 online), 50-amp electric + water, no sewer listed, to 36 ft with six pull-throughs, showers/laundry, reservable. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; units still $26 + utility). No dump station, season, window or stay limits stated for this park (left inherited). Note: dropped the claim that no site is on the creek (the booking site says 34 are adjacent to it).
